categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Xunjiexing Technology Corp. Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its business covers prototype boards, small batch boards, and large batch boards, offering one-stop services from prototype to mass production. The company serves diverse sectors including automotive electronics, computer communications, smart consumer devices, intelligent security, industrial control, medical devices, new energy, and rail transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed numerous proprietary core technologies such as selective local nickel-gold plating, HDI board production, thick copper board manufacturing, high-frequency and high-speed board technologies, server board production, flexible and rigid-flex PCB production, and high-precision multilayer board manufacturing. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including laser imaging, mechanical controlled-depth drilling, resin plugging, and chemical etching. The company also integrates intelligent manufacturing and automation systems to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include well-known domestic and international enterprises such as Hikvision, Dahua Technology, Würth, Beidouxingtong, Sutejuchuang, Mindray Medical, CRRC, Anax, and Daotong Technology. The company serves manufacturers in automotive electronics, 5G/6G communication, AI, IoT, smart hardware, industrial control, medical equipment, and consumer electronics. Its markets span both domestic (primarily South and East China) and international regions including Europe, the US, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Xinfeng (Jiangxi Province), and Zhuhai. It has a subsidiary in Hong Kong for import-export trade. Its sales cover domestic markets, especially South and East China, and export markets including Germany, the UK, and the United States. The company is expanding its overseas market penetration through increased sales teams in Japan, South Korea, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xunjiexing operates primarily in the midstream segment of the PCB supply chain, focusing on PCB manufacturing from prototype to mass production. It also extends its business chain downstream by investing in SMT assembly services through its associate company Xinrui Technology, enhancing its one-stop service capability for customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes intelligent manufacturing, capacity ramp-up, and technological innovation in high-growth sectors such as AI, IoT, automotive electronics, and data centers. It focuses on developing advanced PCB products including HDI, high-frequency, thick copper, flexible, rigid-flex, and server boards. R&D efforts target breakthroughs in 400G optical modules, millimeter-wave radar boards, and high-speed communication boards. The company also invests in digital transformation, engineering automation, and online sales platforms to improve operational efficiency and customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PCB products to downstream manufacturers and supplemented by sales through trading agents. The company signs framework contracts with major customers and recognizes revenue upon delivery and acceptance of products. It also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments, but the core revenue comes from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within the domestic PCB industry, Xunjiexing ranks 78th among the top 100 Chinese PCB companies and is recognized as a leading enterprise specializing in prototype and quick-turn PCB services. It competes with major domestic PCB manufacturers such as Shennan Circuits, XingSen Technology, and Chongda Technology. The company differentiates itself by focusing on small batch, high-mix, and high-complexity PCB production with a one-stop service model from prototype to mass production.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 474.6 million, a 2.26% increase year-over-year, but a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.97 million, reflecting a significant profit decline due to underutilized capacity and increased costs. Total assets grew 10.09% to RMB 1.14 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 680.3 million. The company increased cash flow from operations by 142.8%, indicating improved liquidity despite profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xunjiexing emphasizes its capability to provide multi-variety, small-batch, high-level, and short-lead-time PCB solutions tailored to customer product lifecycle stages. Its one-stop service from prototype to mass production reduces customer development time and risk. The company’s advanced proprietary technologies and intelligent manufacturing processes enable high-quality, cost-effective, and rapid delivery of complex PCB products, particularly suited for emerging high-growth sectors like AI, automotive electronics, and 5G communications.
